reference: Harbor Desktop 0.9.132 Beta; retain its identity and profile sync protocol
availability_probe: Anonymous GET /themes/api/identity/api/me and /themes/api/sync/v1/state returned 401 application/json auth_required on 2026-10-25; no account was created or used
explicit_choice: Account panel shows Community or an HTTPS custom origin before the user enters credentials; changing the origin clears the password
old_sessions: A missing server field belongs to the retired original origin. Sync and logout never send its saved tokens; disconnect keeps journals and device data
local_account_scope: The original origin preserves its legacy user-ID namespace. Replacement origins hash canonical origin and provider ID for household, profile settings, watched-by and appearance journals
network: Known paths and methods only; the existing ephemeral account session refuses redirects and stores no cookies or cache
